text: dsh-video-skills 是面向 DSH 的技能目录插件，在 Web 设置页展示视频制作相关技能，也提供可供模型调用的搜索、安装和卸载工具。用户可按关键词、类别、目录等级、许可证和星数筛选条目；安装时可选择写入 DSH 或 Claude 技能目录，查看进度并取消任务。插件从上游目录获取条目，在网络不可用时使用随包快照，并提供已安装清单和目录刷新。适合想为 DSH 或 Claude 查找、管理视频创作技能的用户。需要 Node.js 20 或更新版本；GitHub 体积查询令牌可选。

dsh-video-skills adds a Web catalog and tools to search, install, and remove video-production skills. Filter by text, category, grade, license, or stars; install to DSH or Claude folders and track progress. It uses a bundled catalog offline. Requires Node.js 20+; a GitHub token is optional.

How can I install a discovered skill into my local DSH or Claude skills folder?
dsh-video-skills 的功能「目录搜索」：搜索视频制作技能目录，可按关键词、技能类别、目录评级、许可证和最低星数筛选，并按星数排序。可通过设置页的筛选栏或视频技能搜索工具使用。
dsh-video-skills 的功能「技能安装」：根据仓库和可选目录路径下载技能归档，定位 SKILL.md 后复制到 DSH 或 Claude 技能目录。任务可查看进度或取消；默认安装到 DSH。
dsh-video-skills 的功能「已安装技能管理」：列出 DSH 和 Claude 技能目录中的已安装项目，并区分带插件标记的项目与外部项目；卸载工具只移除带有本插件标记的目录。
dsh-video-skills 的功能「离线目录回退」：目录请求先使用有效缓存，再尝试读取上游；网络不可用或响应无效时改用随包快照，并将结果标记为过期。
dsh-video-skills 使用前须知：安装操作会从 codeload.github.com 下载用户指定的 GitHub 仓库归档，并将技能文件写入选定的本地技能目录。
dsh-video-skills 使用前须知：目录和仓库体积查询会请求上游 Raw GitHub 内容及 GitHub API；GITHUB_TOKEN 或 GH_TOKEN（若设置）用于 GitHub API 请求。

dsh-video-skills README · dsh-video-skills：`dsh-video-skills` is a DSH web plugin that lists the [awesome-claude-video-skills](https://github.com/zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills) catalog in one settings page and installs a chosen repository's skill into `~/.claude/skills` or `~/.dsh/skills` by downloading its GitHub archive and copying files — no code from the installed repository is ever executed.

Chinese documentation: [README.zh-CN.md](./README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-video-skills README · What the plugin adds：- One page seat in the DSH settings UI (`key: video-skills`, `order: 900`): an **Install to** bar with `Claude` / `DSH` checkboxes (only `DSH` is checked by default and the choice is remembered in `localStorage`), an **installed only** filter, and the filter bar (kind chips, minimum stars, grade, license, search) over a list of at most 100 rows with "load more". Each row links to its GitHub repository and to the skill path inside it, carries an approximate repository-size badge (`≈ 27.4 MB`, or `—` while the size is not known yet), shows download progress as an indeterminate bar (`downloaded <n> MB`, then `archive <n> MB / <m> files`, then `copying <n> files`) with a cancel button, ticks every installed target, and uninstalls in two clicks. Copy is bilingual — `zh-CN` default, `en-US` available — and every string lives in `locale/*.json`.
- Three model tools: `video_skill_search`, `video_skill_install` and `video_skill_uninstall`.
- One HTTP prefix route, `/video-skills/api/v1`, that the page talks to. The route is served even when no tool registry is composed, and the tools are registered only when one is.

dsh-video-skills README · Requirements：- Node.js 20 or newer (`engines` in `package.json`).
- Any DSH composition. The entry declares `inject = []` and resolves its services reactively: the tools appear whenever a `tools` service exists, and the HTTP route is mounted only when `webServer` exists, so CLI and TUI sessions still get all three tools.
- Runtime dependency: `tar` (used to stream, list and extract the downloaded archive). Nothing else is installed at runtime.

dsh-video-skills README · Installation：Installed from the registry into a DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-video-skills
```

`dsh plugin` forwards the remaining arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory, so the package is pinned as a profile dependency. A profile composes the plugins named in `dsh.profile.bundles` of its own `package.json`, so `"dsh-video-skills"` must also appear in that array:

dsh-video-skills README · Tools：All three tools work in any composition — CLI, TUI, or Web. Only the browse-and-install page needs the Web UI; without a web server the plugin simply registers the tools and mounts no HTTP route.

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_search`：| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | — | Case-insensitive substring match over repository name and description. |
| `kind` | string | — | Exact kind: `general`, `promo`, `explainer`, `editing`, `shorts`, `avatar`, `story`, `motion`, `craft`, `music`. |
| `grade` | `safe` \| `caution` | — | Security grade recorded by the catalog. |
| `license` | string | — | Exact license id, matched case-insensitively. |
| `minStars` | integer | — | Only entries with at least this many stars. |
| `limit` | integer | `20` | Page size, clamped to 1–100. |

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_search`：Returns `{ count, items }`: `count` is the number of matches before the page limit, `items` is the page sorted by stars descending. Each entry carries `repo`, `path`, `stars`, `description`, `kind`, `grade`, `language`, `license`, `previewUrl` and `sizeBytes`. `sizeBytes` is the cached GitHub repository size in bytes — the same value `GET /catalog` serves for the same entry, because the tools and the route share one catalog loader (`createToolCatalogLoader`). It is `null` while the cache holds no value for that repository yet, and the field is declared as a nullable number in the tool's output schema (see [Repository sizes](#repository-sizes)).

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_install`：| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `repo` (required) | string | — | `owner/name`; an `https://github.com/` prefix and a `.git` suffix are stripped. |
| `path` | string | detected | Skill directory inside the repository. Omit to pick the shallowest `SKILL.md`. |
| `name` | string | detected | Override the installed skill directory name. |
| `targets` | array of `claude` \| `dsh` | `["dsh"]` | Skill roots to install into; duplicates are dropped. |

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_install`：Returns the engine result — on success `{ ok: true, name, installed: [{ target, dir, files }], warnings: string[] }`; on failure `{ ok: false, error, message?, dir? }` with `error` one of `bad-repo`, `bad-targets`, `fetch-failed`, `no-skill-md`, `exists`. The tool awaits the whole engine and returns only the final result — no job object and no intermediate progress; the page uses `POST /install` and polls the job for progress.

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_uninstall`：| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | string | — | Skill directory name, as listed by `GET /installed`. |
| `target` (required) | `claude` \| `dsh` | — | Skill root to remove it from. |

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_uninstall`：Returns `{ ok: true, removed: { name, target, dir } }`, or `{ ok: false, error }` with `bad-name`, `bad-target`, `not-found` or `not-owned`. Only a directory carrying this plugin's `.dsh-video-skills.json` marker is removed; a skill someone copied in by hand is refused with `not-owned` and never touched.

dsh-video-skills README · HTTP API：Base path `/video-skills/api/v1`, same origin, no authentication. Every response is JSON with `cache-control: no-store`; a request body on a POST route is capped at 64 KiB (`MAX_BODY_BYTES`).

dsh-video-skills README · HTTP API：| Method | Path | Success | Failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/catalog` | `200` catalog payload | none — an unreachable upstream yields the bundled snapshot with `stale: true` |
| `GET` | `/installed` | `200 {"ok":true,"items":[{"name","target","dir","repo","path","installedAt","files","bytes","owned","external"}]}`; `bytes` is the measured on-disk size of the installed directory, counted without the marker file and without `.git`/`node_modules` | none |
| `POST` | `/install` | `202 {"ok":true,"job"}` — the install runs in the background | `400` with `error` `bad-body`, `bad-repo` or `bad-targets`; `409 {"ok":false,"error":"busy"}` once eight jobs are running |
| `GET` | `/install/<id>` | `200 {"ok":true,"job"}` | `404 {"ok":false,"error":"unknown-job"}` |
| `POST` | `/install/<id>/cancel` | `200 {"ok":true,"job"}` — a settled job comes back unchanged | `404` `unknown-job` |
| `POST` | `/uninstall` | `200 {"ok":true,"removed":{"name","target","dir"}}` | `400` `bad-body` \| `bad-name` \| `bad-target`; `404` `not-found`; `409 {"ok":false,"error":"not-owned"}` when the directory has no marker |
| `POST` | `/refresh` | `200 {"ok":true,"ge

dsh-video-skills README · HTTP API：A job is `{ id, repo, targets, phase, bytes, archiveBytes, files, copied, name, installed, warnings, error, message, startedAt, updatedAt }` where `phase` is one of `queued`, `download`, `inspect`, `extract`, `copy`, `done`, `error`, `cancelled`. `bytes` counts the archive received so far, `archiveBytes` is the final archive size and stays `null` until the download finishes, `copied` the files written so far. Cancelling aborts the download and removes every directory the job had already written. At most 32 jobs are retained, a finished job stays readable for ten minutes. The page polls every 500 ms.

dsh-video-skills README · HTTP API：An exception inside the handler is answered as `500 {"ok":false,"error":"internal","message"}`.

Catalog payload:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "generated": "2026-10-28",
  "source": "https://github.com/zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills",

dsh-video-skills README · HTTP API：`generated` is copied from upstream and may be `null`; `grade` is `safe` unless the catalog marks the entry `caution`. `sizeBytes` and `sizes` are computed locally from the size cache: `sizes.known` counts the entries that carry a size and `sizes.total` is the catalog size — see [Repository sizes](#repository-sizes).

dsh-video-skills README · Install targets and environment overrides：| Target | Default root | Environment override |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claude` | `~/.claude/skills` | `DSH_VIDEO_SKILLS_CLAUDE_ROOT` |
| `dsh` | `~/.dsh/skills` | `DSH_VIDEO_SKILLS_DSH_ROOT` |

What an install does:

dsh-video-skills README · Install targets and environment overrides：1. Download `https://codeload.github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tar.gz/HEAD` into a fresh temporary directory. The download is aborted past 512 MiB, and the refusal reports the byte count actually received — `archive exceeds the 512 MiB download budget (received <n> bytes)`.
2. Resolve the skill directory: the explicit `path` when given, otherwise the shallowest `SKILL.md` in the archive — ties go to a directory named after the repository, then alphabetically.
3. Copy that directory into `<root>/<name>`, skipping `.git/**`, `node_modules/**` and any file above 10 MiB. Every skip is appended to `warnings` as `skipped:<reason>:<path>`.
4. Write `<root>/<name>/.dsh-video-skills.json` = `{ repo, path, ref: "HEAD", installedAt, files }`.

dsh-video-skills README · Install targets and environment overrides：The directory name comes from the `name` parameter, then the `name` field of the target `SKILL.md` frontmatter, then the directory basename, then `skill`; it is lowercased and reduced to `[a-z0-9._-]`, at most 64 characters.

Conflicts: a target directory with no marker, or whose marker names a different repository, is refused with `exists`. A marker for the same repository makes the install an overwrite.

dsh-video-skills README · Install targets and environment overrides：Progress and cancel: the engine reports `{ phase, bytes, archiveBytes, files, copied }` at most ten times a second, and at least 100 ms apart inside one phase, so a single job cannot flood the page. `bytes` grows while the archive streams in, but the total is unknown during the download: `codeload.github.com` sends no `Content-Length`, so the page renders an indeterminate bar instead of a percentage. When the download completes the job carries `archiveBytes`, and the finish line reports it together with the file count (`Archive <n> MB / <m> files`). Cancelling throws away the temporary tree and every directory the job already copied into. A cancelled overwrite therefore does not restore the previous version — it is a cleanup, not a rollback.

dsh-video-skills README · Install targets and environment overrides：Uninstall: only a directory carrying this plugin's marker is removed. `GET /installed` also lists skill roots it does not own — a directory with a `SKILL.md` but no marker comes back with `owned: false, external: true`, appears as an external entry in the page, and has no uninstall button.

DSH watches both skill roots, so a newly installed skill becomes available without any rescan command.

dsh-video-skills README · Security posture：- No `child_process`, no shell, no `npm`, no `git` anywhere in `src/` — the only runtime dependency is `tar`.
- Nothing from the downloaded archive is executed. The tarball is listed and its entries are copied; no postinstall, no script from the repository, no build step.
- Archive entries are validated: an entry that escapes the extraction root is a hard error, and both listing and extraction run with `strict: true`.
- Files only: the engine writes the skill directory and the marker file and nothing else. A path-traversal entry or an unusable `path` parameter is rejected rather than repaired.
- A directory this plugin did not create is never overwritten, and an uninstall removes a directory only when its marker proves this plugin installed it.
- The page makes same-origin requests to `/video-skills/api/v1` only; preview images are loaded from `raw.githubusercontent.com`. There is no write path into the catalog.

dsh-video-skills README · Catalog, cache, and offline snapshot：- Upstream JSON: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills/HEAD/data/skills.json`.
- Cache file: `~/.dsh/video-skills/catalog.json`, reused while younger than 24 h.
- Fetch budget for one request: 15 s.
- `GET /catalog` reads cache, then network (writing the result back to the cache), then the bundled `data/skills.json` marked `stale: true`. It never fails.
- `POST /refresh` skips the cache and answers `502` when the fetch fails.
- Preview images are not bundled. `previewUrl` points at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills/HEAD/assets/previews/<owner>__<repo>.jpg`.
dsh-video-skills README · Repository sizes：The page shows how large a repository is before you download it. The number comes from GitHub, not from the archive.

dsh-video-skills README · Repository sizes：- Source: `GET https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>`, field `size`. GitHub reports it in kilobytes and covers the whole repository including `.git`, so it is the repository size, not the size of the `tar.gz` the installer downloads — which is why the badge is written with a leading `≈`.
- Cache file: `~/.dsh/video-skills/sizes.json`. An entry is reused for 7 days (`SIZE_TTL_MS`). A repository GitHub reports as missing — a `404`, or a `size` that is not a non-negative number — is remembered as missing for the same 7 days, and a reported `size` of `0` counts as unknown.
- Warming: five repositories per batch (`SIZE_WARM_BATCH`): one batch at startup, one every 60 s (`SIZE_WARM_INTERVAL_MS`), and one more on every `GET /catalog` read. Unauthenticated GitHub allows 60 requests per hour, so a cold cache fills in roughly 60 repositories per hour; only repositories currently in the catalog are asked for.
- Backoff: a batch stops as soon as GitHub answers `403` or `429`, or reports `x-ratelimit-remaining` at 5 or below (`RATE_LIMIT_FLOOR`). Warming then pauses until `x-ratelimit-reset`, or for 10 minutes when that header is absent. Three co

dsh-video-skills README · Repository layout：```
src/host/index.js        Cordis plugin entry: the HTTP prefix route and tool registration
src/host/catalog.js      fetch, 24 h cache, snapshot fallback, size join, filtering
src/host/sizes.js        GitHub repository-size cache, TTL, and background warmer
src/host/install.js      archive download, skill-directory detection, copy engine, uninstall

dsh-video-skills README · License and data provenance：- Plugin code: MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE). Copyright (c) 2026 dujiacheng.
- Bundled catalog data `data/skills.json`: an unmodified snapshot of `data/skills.json` from <https://github.com/zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills> (commit ref `HEAD`, 373 entries), released upstream under **CC0 1.0 Universal** and redistributed here under the same terms. The full credit is in [data/NOTICE.md](./data/NOTICE.md).
- The snapshot is a fallback only: at runtime a freshly fetched upstream copy is preferred, and the snapshot is served marked `stale: true`.

dsh-video-skills README · dsh-video-skills：`dsh-video-skills` 是一个 DSH Web 插件：在设置页中浏览 [awesome-claude-video-skills](https://github.com/zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills) 目录，并通过下载 GitHub 归档、复制文件的方式，把所选仓库的技能安装到 `~/.claude/skills` 或 `~/.dsh/skills`，全程不执行仓库中的任何代码。

English documentation: [README.md](./README.md)

dsh-video-skills README · 插件提供什么：- DSH 设置界面中的一个页面席位（`key: video-skills`，`order: 900`）：顶部"安装到"一栏有 `Claude` / `DSH` 两个复选框（默认只勾 `DSH`，选择记在 `localStorage`），另有"只看已安装"筛选；下方是筛选栏（类型标签、最低星数、评级、许可证、搜索）与最多 100 行的列表、"加载更多"。每行可跳转到对应的 GitHub 仓库与仓库内的技能目录，并带一个约等于的仓库体积徽章（`≈ 27.4 MB`，尚未取到时显示 `—`），安装时以不确定形态的进度条显示下载进度（`已下载 <n> MB`，随后 `归档 <n> MB / <m> 文件`，再 `拷贝 <n> 文件`），并提供取消按钮，已安装的目标打勾，卸载需点两次确认。文案支持中英双语，默认 `zh-CN`，可选 `en-US`，所有字符串都在 `locale/*.json` 中。
- 三个模型工具：`video_skill_search`、`video_skill_install` 与 `video_skill_uninstall`。
- 一条 HTTP 前缀路由 `/video-skills/api/v1`，供页面调用。即使宿主没有组合出工具注册表，该路由仍然提供服务；工具只在注册表存在时才注册。

dsh-video-skills README · 环境要求：- Node.js 20 或更高版本（`package.json` 中的 `engines`）。
- 任意 DSH 组合。入口声明 `inject = []` 并按服务响应式注入：存在 `tools` 服务时就注册工具，存在 `webServer` 时才挂 HTTP 路由，因此 CLI 与 TUI 会话同样能用上三个工具。
- 运行时依赖：`tar`（用于流式下载、列出与解压归档）。除此之外运行时不再安装其他依赖。

dsh-video-skills README · 安装：从登记处安装到某个 DSH 配置档：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-video-skills
```

`dsh plugin` 会把后续参数转发给配置档目录中的 pnpm，因此该包会被固定为该配置档的依赖。配置档只组合其 `package.json` 中 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列出的插件，所以还需要把 `"dsh-video-skills"` 加入该数组：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-video-skills"]

本地开发，直接使用本仓库的检出目录：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:/绝对路径/dsh-plugin-video-skills
```
dsh-video-skills README · 安装：`link:` 建立的是符号链接而不是拷贝，后续改动无需重装即可生效；若 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里还没有 `"dsh-video-skills"`，再补上。
dsh-video-skills README · 工具：三个工具在任何组合里都可用——CLI、TUI、Web 都行。只有浏览安装页面需要 Web UI；没有 Web 服务时插件只注册工具，不挂任何 HTTP 路由。

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_search`：| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | — | 对仓库名与描述做不区分大小写的子串匹配。 |
| `kind` | string | — | 精确类型：`general`、`promo`、`explainer`、`editing`、`shorts`、`avatar`、`story`、`motion`、`craft`、`music`。 |
| `grade` | `safe` \| `caution` | — | 目录记录的安全评级。 |
| `license` | string | — | 精确许可证标识，不区分大小写。 |
| `minStars` | integer | — | 只保留星数不低于该值的条目。 |
| `limit` | integer | `20` | 分页大小，限制在 1–100。 |

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_search`：返回 `{ count, items }`：`count` 是分页前的命中总数，`items` 是按星数降序排列的当前页。每个条目包含 `repo`、`path`、`stars`、`description`、`kind`、`grade`、`language`、`license`、`previewUrl` 与 `sizeBytes`。`sizeBytes` 是缓存的 GitHub 仓库体积（字节），与 `GET /catalog` 对同一条目给出的值同源同值——工具与路由共用同一个目录加载器（`createToolCatalogLoader`）。缓存里还没有该仓库的值时为 `null`（字段照常存在，只是取值为 null），工具的声明式输出结构中也以可空数字声明（见[仓库体积](#仓库体积)）。

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_install`：| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `repo`（必填） | string | — | `owner/name`；会去掉 `https://github.com/` 前缀与 `.git` 后缀。 |
| `path` | string | 自动探测 | 仓库内的技能目录；省略时取最浅的 `SKILL.md`。 |
| `name` | string | 自动探测 | 覆盖安装后的技能目录名。 |
| `targets` | `claude` \| `dsh` 的数组 | `["dsh"]` | 要安装到的技能根目录；重复项会被去掉。 |

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_install`：返回引擎结果——成功时 `{ ok: true, name, installed: [{ target, dir, files }], warnings: string[] }`；失败时 `{ ok: false, error, message?, dir? }`，`error` 取值 `bad-repo`、`bad-targets`、`fetch-failed`、`no-skill-md`、`exists`。工具会等整个引擎跑完，只返回最终结果——没有任务对象，也没有中间进度；页面走 `POST /install` 并轮询任务对象取进度。

dsh-video-skills README · `video_skill_uninstall`：| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name`（必填） | string | — | 技能目录名，取自 `GET /installed`。 |
| `target`（必填） | `claude` \| `dsh` | — | 要从哪个技能根目录移除。 |

成功返回 `{ ok: true, removed: { name, target, dir } }`；失败返回 `{ ok: false, error }`，`error` 取 `bad-name`、`bad-target`、`not-found` 或 `not-owned`。只有带本插件 `.dsh-video-skills.json` 标记的目录会被删除；手工拷进去的技能以 `not-owned` 拒绝，永不触碰。

一次安装的流程：

dsh-video-skills README · 安装目标与环境变量：1. 把 `https://codeload.github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tar.gz/HEAD` 下载到一个新建的临时目录；超过 512 MiB 立即中断，并报出实际收到的字节数——`archive exceeds the 512 MiB download budget (received <n> bytes)`。
2. 解析技能目录：给了 `path` 就用它，否则取归档中最浅的 `SKILL.md`——同层时优先目录名与仓库名相同者，其次按字典序。
3. 把该目录复制到 `<root>/<name>`，跳过 `.git/**`、`node_modules/**` 以及任何大于 10 MiB 的文件；每次跳过都会以 `skipped:<原因>:<路径>` 追加到 `warnings`。
4. 写入 `<root>/<name>/.dsh-video-skills.json` = `{ repo, path, ref: "HEAD", installedAt, files }`。

dsh-video-skills README · 安装目标与环境变量：目录名的解析顺序为：`name` 参数 → 目标 `SKILL.md` frontmatter 的 `name` 字段 → 目录基名 → `skill`；随后统一转小写并收敛为 `[a-z0-9._-]`，最多 64 个字符。

冲突处理：目标目录没有标记文件，或标记文件指向另一个仓库时，以 `exists` 拒绝；标记文件指向同一仓库时，本次安装为覆盖。

进度与取消：引擎每秒最多上报 10 次 `{ phase, bytes, archiveBytes, files, copied }`，同一阶段内两次之间至少间隔 100 毫秒，单个任务不会刷爆页面。`bytes` 在归档流式下载时持续增长，但下载过程中总量不可知：`codeload.github.com` 不返回 `Content-Length`，所以页面画的是不确定形态的进度条，而不是百分比。下载结束后任务带上 `archiveBytes`，结束行会连同文件数一起报出（`归档 <n> MB / <m> 文件`）。取消会删掉临时目录树以及该任务已经拷进技能根的每一个目录。因此取消一次覆盖安装不会恢复旧版本——这是清理，不是回滚。

dsh-video-skills README · 安装目标与环境变量：卸载：只删带本插件标记的目录。`GET /installed` 同时会列出不属于本插件的技能——目录里有 `SKILL.md` 但没有标记时返回 `owned: false, external: true`，页面上显示为"外部安装"，不提供卸载按钮。

DSH 会监视两个技能根目录，因此新安装的技能会自动生效，不需要任何重新扫描命令。

dsh-video-skills README · 安全设计：- `src/` 中没有任何 `child_process`、没有 shell、不调用 `npm` 或 `git`——运行时唯一依赖是 `tar`。
- 归档中的内容不会被任何形式执行：只做列出与复制，没有 postinstall，不运行仓库中的脚本，也没有构建步骤。
- 归档条目会被校验：越出解压根目录的条目直接报错，列出与解压都使用 `strict: true`。
- 只写文件：引擎只写技能目录与标记文件。路径穿越条目或不可用的 `path` 参数会被拒绝，而不是被修补。
- 不是本插件创建的目录永远不会被覆盖；卸载时只有标记文件能证明是本插件装的目录才会被删除。
- 页面只向同源的 `/video-skills/api/v1` 发起请求；预览图来自 `raw.githubusercontent.com`。目录没有写入路径。

dsh-video-skills README · 目录、缓存与离线快照：- 上游 JSON：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills/HEAD/data/skills.json`。
- 缓存文件：`~/.dsh/video-skills/catalog.json`，24 小时内直接复用。
- 单次请求的网络预算：15 秒。
- `GET /catalog` 依次读取缓存、网络（结果写回缓存）、随包的 `data/skills.json`（标记 `stale: true`）；该接口不会失败。
- `POST /refresh` 跳过缓存，抓取失败时返回 `502`。
- 预览图不随包分发，`previewUrl` 指向 `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills/HEAD/assets/previews/<owner>__<repo>.jpg`。

dsh-video-skills README · 仓库体积：- 来源：`GET https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>` 的 `size` 字段。GitHub 以千字节为单位返回，并计入包含 `.git` 在内的整个仓库，因此它是仓库体积而不是安装时下载的 `tar.gz` 大小——徽章前面带 `≈` 就是这个原因。
- 缓存文件：`~/.dsh/video-skills/sizes.json`。每个条目复用 7 天（`SIZE_TTL_MS`）。GitHub 报告为不存在的仓库——`404`，或 `size` 不是非负数——同样按缺失记住 7 天；返回的 `size` 为 `0` 时按未知处理。
- 预取：每批 5 个仓库（`SIZE_WARM_BATCH`），启动时一批，之后每 60 秒一批（`SIZE_WARM_INTERVAL_MS`），另外每次读取 `GET /catalog` 再踢一批。未认证的 GitHub 限额是每小时 60 次请求，所以冷缓存下大约每小时补齐 60 个仓库；只会查询当前目录里的仓库。
- 退避：GitHub 返回 `403` 或 `429`，或 `x-ratelimit-remaining` 不高于 5（`RATE_LIMIT_FLOOR`）时本批立即停止；随后暂停到 `x-ratelimit-reset` 指定的时刻，没有该响应头时暂停 10 分钟。连续 3 次传输失败（`MAX_FAILURES`）就放弃本批，等下一个周期再试。
- 令牌：可选。可用 `GITHUB_TOKEN`，没有时回退到 `GH_TOKEN`，以提高限额。它只作为 bearer 令牌发给 `api.github.com`，绝不会发给提供归档的 `codeload.github.com`。
- 未知体积：取不到可用体积的条目返回 `sizeBytes: null`，页面显示 `—`，悬浮提示说明尚未取到；GitHub 回 `404` 的仓库按缺失缓存，因此它会一直显示 `—`，而不会每批重新去问。任何环节都不会等待体积：即使整列都是空的，目录、搜索与安装照常工作。
